file_metadata.description: Systematic ordinary of the Vesperal Liturgy, mapping the Vespers opening, readings sequence, transition gate, and Liturgy ordinary.

roles.priest: Open royal doors, stand before Holy Table, exclaim: 'Blessed is the kingdom...'
roles.deacon: Stand at right hand, raise orarion, exclaim: 'Bless, Master.'

roles.priest: Exit sanctuary via north door to read Vespers Prayers 4-8 silently before closed royal doors.
roles.deacon: Close royal doors, stand with candle before them.
roles.cantor: Chant Psalm 103 ('Bless the Lord, O my soul').

roles.priest: Stand inside Altar, exclaim: 'For to You is due all glory...'
roles.deacon: Exclaim Great Synapte from before the royal doors.

roles.priest: Read Vespers Prayers 1-3 silently during Antiphons.
roles.deacon: Exclaim Small Synapte after each antiphon.
roles.cantor: Chant the appointed Kathisma (suppressed on certain Eve feasts).

roles.deacon: Perform full censing of Altar and church, censing the local icons and choirs.
roles.cantor: Chant 'Lord, I have cried...' with stichera from Menaion or Triodion.

roles.priest: Carry the Gospel book in the Entrance procession (or censer if standard). Exclaim Entrance prayer secretly.
roles.deacon: Carry censer, walk ahead of priest. Exclaim: 'Wisdom! Stand aright!'

roles.priest: Sit on high place or stand at Holy Table during the readings.
roles.deacon: Exclaim: 'Wisdom!', 'Let us be attentive!' before and after reading titles.
roles.cantor: Chant the appointed Old Testament Paremias.

roles.priest: Return to Holy Table, stand inside Altar. Exclaim the Liturgy Trisagion exclamation.
roles.deacon: Stand at Holy Table. Exclaim: 'Let us pray to the Lord.'
roles.cantor: Chant the Trisagion (or 'As many as have been baptized...' on Great Saturday/Christmas/Theophany).

roles.priest: Read Gospel facing people from soleas or royal doors. Bless: 'Peace be to all.'
roles.cantor: Chant the Epistle, Alleluia, and respond to the Gospel.

rubric.title: The Liturgy of the Faithful and Great Entrance

roles.priest: Recite Cherubic Hymn silently. Process diskos and chalice through royal doors. Place on Holy Table. Close doors and curtain.
roles.deacon: Perform opening censing. Process before priest with censer.

roles.priest: Exclaim the Institution Narratives: 'Take, eat...', 'Drink of this...'. Blessing and consecration of Gifts. Elevate: 'Thine of Thine own...'
roles.deacon: Elevate diskos and chalice during elevation.

roles.priest: Communicate inside Altar, distribute Communion to faithful.
roles.deacon: Assist at Communion, close royal doors after Liturgy.
